params.purpose: Weight of the squared load-excess term u_L²
params.rationale: Loading is the primary driver of overload in the twin (state labels use L ≥ 115 %). A value of 2 makes D ≈ 0.48 when a unit reaches 100 % with an ONAN safe limit of 80 %, i.e. action starts before the 115 % overload label.
params.effect: Larger α → disturbance detected at lower loading; smaller α → later detection.
params.tuning: Sweep α in Load-Ramp runs and choose the smallest value for which D crosses D_act before the twin labels OVERLOAD.

params.purpose: Weight of the squared temperature-excess term u_T²
params.rationale: Temperature carries the slow, cumulative part of the risk and controls when recovery can be confirmed; it is weighted slightly above load so a hot unit is not declared recovered just because its load dropped.
params.effect: Larger β → longer recovery confirmation after a transfer.
params.tuning: Run the overload→transfer scenario and pick β so that recovery is confirmed when θ falls a few kelvin above T_safe.

params.purpose: Weight of the voltage-deviation term u_V
params.rationale: Voltage sags in the twin (−5 % to −15 %) are secondary disturbances; γ = 0.8 makes a 10 % sag alone give D ≈ 0.79, i.e. a warning/action on its own.
params.effect: Larger γ → more sensitive to sags.
params.tuning: Use Voltage-Sag scenario runs; γ should make the sag window D ≥ D_warn.

params.purpose: Weight of the current-consistency term u_I
params.rationale: u_I flags current that is not explained by the loading (sag or fault current). Unit weight keeps it comparable to the other terms.
params.effect: Larger δ → faster reaction to fault currents.
params.tuning: Fault-Event runs: δ should push D above D_crit during the fault window.

params.purpose: Weight of the load × temperature synergy term u_L·u_T
params.rationale: An overload on an already hot transformer is worse than either condition alone (ageing accelerates with both). The cross term adds risk only when both are present.
params.effect: Larger κ → stronger penalty for simultaneous load and thermal excess.
params.tuning: Compare a cold and a pre-heated overload with equal load; κ sets how much earlier the hot case escalates.

params.purpose: Voltage-deviation dead-band
params.rationale: The twin drops voltage by 2.5 % at rated load by design; deviations within 3 % are normal regulation, not a disturbance.
params.effect: Larger d_V → ignores bigger deviations.
params.tuning: Set just above the largest deviation seen in Normal-Operation runs.

params.purpose: Voltage-deviation scale beyond the dead-band
params.rationale: A further 5 % deviation (8 % total) gives u_V = 1, a full-weight voltage disturbance.
params.effect: Smaller ε_V → u_V grows faster.
params.tuning: Match to the statutory voltage band used by the utility (±5 % to ±10 %).

params.purpose: Dead-band of the current-consistency ratio
params.rationale: With noise and the small load-dependent voltage drop the ratio (I/I_r)/(L/100) stays within 5 % of 1 in normal operation.
params.effect: Larger d_I → ignores bigger current mismatches.
params.tuning: Set above the 99th percentile of the ratio in Normal-Operation data.

params.purpose: Scale of the current-consistency excess
params.rationale: A current 30 % above what the load explains gives u_I = 1.
params.effect: Smaller σ_I → u_I grows faster.
params.tuning: Fault-Event data: choose so fault windows give u_I ≫ 1.

params.purpose: Load at which the twin labels OVERLOAD
params.rationale: Taken from the twin labelling rule (Eq. 8 of the paper).
params.effect: Normalises u_L.
params.tuning: Fixed by the labelling rule.

params.purpose: Temperature at which the twin labels OVERLOAD
params.rationale: Taken from the twin labelling rule.
params.effect: Normalises u_T.
params.tuning: Fixed by the labelling rule.

params.purpose: Nominal primary voltage
params.rationale: All four units are 11/0.415 kV.
params.effect: Reference for u_V.

params.purpose: Rate at which accumulated abnormal exposure W_i lowers health
params.rationale: 30 min of full-severity abnormal operation (D = 1) reduces the permanent part of H to e⁻¹ ≈ 37 %.
params.effect: Larger λ_W → faster permanent decline.
params.tuning: Choose so that the Sustained-Overload scenario (300 s at D ≈ 1) costs a few percent of health.

params.purpose: Permanent penalty per self-healing event N_i
params.rationale: Each event that needs coordinated relief leaves a 2 % mark (recovery history).
params.effect: Larger ψ → repeated events count more.
params.tuning: Set from how many events per year a utility tolerates before inspection.

params.purpose: Maximum recoverable derating from short-term stress S_i
params.rationale: Up to 40 % of health can be temporarily lost while the unit is stressed and is regained as it cools.
params.effect: Larger ω → health dips more during an event.
params.tuning: Tune visually against the thermal recovery time of the twin.

params.purpose: Sensitivity of the recoverable part to stress S_i
params.rationale: 120 s·D² of stress gives 63 % of the maximum recoverable derating.
params.effect: Larger λ_S → stress shows up faster.
params.tuning: As for ω.

params.purpose: Half-life of the short-term stress memory S_i
params.rationale: Matches the order of the twin thermal time constants (τ_s = 180–300 steps).
params.effect: Longer t_½ → slower recovery of H.
params.tuning: Set close to the median τ_s of the four units.

params.purpose: Only D above this value counts as abnormal exposure W_i
params.rationale: Same threshold as warning mode, so normal fluctuations do not age the score.

params.purpose: Weight of capacity coverage c_j
params.rationale: The first purpose of a supporter is to absorb the excess power.
params.effect: Larger → prefers big-headroom units.
params.tuning: Rank stability check across T1–T4 overload cases.

params.purpose: Weight of supporter health H_j/100
params.rationale: A degraded unit should not be loaded further.
params.effect: Larger → prefers healthy units.
params.tuning: As above.

params.purpose: Weight of overload risk ρ_j
params.rationale: Penalises supporters that would end close to their own safe limit.
params.effect: Larger → spreads load over more supporters.
params.tuning: Increase if supporters end in WARNING after transfers.

params.purpose: Weight of supporter disturbance D_j
params.rationale: A supporter already disturbed should help last.

params.purpose: Steepness of the risk curve (L_j′/L_safe,j)^η
params.rationale: Risk stays small at moderate post-transfer loading and rises sharply near L_safe.
params.effect: Larger η → risk only near the limit.

params.purpose: Minimum health for a unit to be allowed to support
params.rationale: Below 60 the unit is treated as degraded.
params.effect: Higher → fewer eligible supporters.

params.purpose: Minimum coordination score for eligibility
params.rationale: Excludes supporters with negligible net benefit.

params.purpose: Smallest headroom worth negotiating
params.rationale: Avoids splitting transfers into negligible parts.

params.purpose: Enter warning mode
params.rationale: About 90 % loading on an ONAN unit.
params.tuning: Lower → earlier warnings.

params.purpose: Start coordinated self-healing
params.rationale: About 100 % loading on an ONAN unit, before the 115 % overload label.
params.tuning: Lower → earlier action, more transfers.

params.purpose: Below this value a unit counts as recovered
params.rationale: Below the warning threshold with margin (hysteresis).

params.purpose: Critical disturbance
params.rationale: Combined with low health it triggers isolation.

params.purpose: Health below which a critical unit is flagged for isolation
params.rationale: Do not keep stressing a badly degraded unit.

params.purpose: Minimum fraction of the required relief that supporters must offer
params.rationale: Below 25 % coverage a transfer is not worth it; flag instead.

params.purpose: Consecutive seconds with D < D_rec needed to confirm recovery
params.rationale: Prevents declaring recovery on a single noisy sample.

params.purpose: Time allowed for recovery before escalation
params.rationale: About four times the largest τ_s.

params.purpose: Escalate to isolation if D stays ≥ D_act this long after a transfer
params.rationale: Partial relief that leaves the unit overloaded must not be tolerated for long; 30 s is short compared with the thermal time constants, so the unit is still cool when the flag is raised.
params.effect: Shorter → faster escalation after insufficient relief.
params.tuning: Must exceed τ_c plus the twin load-settling time (~5 s).

params.purpose: Simulated message latency per coordination stage
params.rationale: Makes each stage (alert, offers, decision) visible and gives agents time to respond.

params.purpose: Margin for the twin's normal load swing
params.rationale: The Normal-Operation profile varies load by ±5 % (sinusoid); targets and supporter limits keep this margin so units do not cross a threshold on the next swing.
params.effect: Larger m_L → more relief requested, less load accepted by each supporter.
params.tuning: Set to the amplitude of normal load variation observed in the dataset.

params.purpose: Load at which the twin labels WARNING
params.rationale: Supporters are never planned above the twin's own warning threshold, even if their cooling class would allow more.
params.effect: Caps the headroom of ONAF/OFAF units.
params.tuning: Fixed by the labelling rule.
